visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a grey t-shirt and glasses performing a manual adjustment on a woman lying face down on a massage table. The camera uses a dramatic zoom effect with black lines radiating inward. (2) A transition shows the woman's back and buttocks in a yellow tank top and white underwear, highlighting a larger physique. Text overlays and emojis appear. (3) The scene shifts to the woman standing in front of a mirror wearing pink knit top and black shorts, showcasing a slimmer hip profile. She then appears in a denim skirt, showing an 'S' size label. (4) The woman is seen arriving at a storefront labeled 'EMC'. She enters a brightly lit indoor space and greets a male staff member wearing a mask. (5) Inside a treatment room with a massage table, the man in the grey t-shirt begins massaging the woman's back through a blue cloth. (6) A split-screen comparison shows the 'Before' and 'After' hip height while she lies on the table. (7) The man performs various manual pelvic adjustments, pushing and stretching the woman's legs and hips. An instructional animation of a pelvis is overlaid. (8) A close-up shows a yellow tape measure measuring the woman's hip circumference, moving from 88.5cm down to 85.5cm. (9) The woman, lying on her back with a mask on, gives two thumbs up to the camera. (10) Final scenes show the woman celebrating and dancing in the treatment room, then posing in a gym and mirror, showing her toned lower body.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, energetic pop music with a strong drum machine beat begins immediately. A high-pitched female voice speaks excitedly about her hips. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effects plays as the scene changes to the shop entrance. (3) The music ducks slightly in volume as a calm, professional male voice explains the technical aspects of muscle relaxation and pelvic health. (4) A loud, sharp 'crack' or 'pop' sound effect (simulating a joint adjustment) occurs in sync with the visual of the therapist pressing the patient's hip. (5) Multiple rapid 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects trigger as measurement text and 'before/after' graphics appear on screen. (6) The female voice returns with high arousal and positive valence, celebrating the results. The music maintains its driving tempo until the very end.
